messages:
Jon: hey team :wave: quick idea from last night's paging mess — proposal to reduce churn during incidents and stop action items from falling through cracks. thinking two lightweight pieces: a) a simple "handoff ledger" (central ledger of ongoing incident handoffs + owner + status + links) and b) a `snoozebot` that lets oncall snooze followups and schedule postmortem booking. short reason: we keep getting duplicated PMs, stale action items, and noisy followups that interrupt mitigation.

Maria: love the idea. can you sketch how the ledger differs from the existing postmortem spreadsheet? that's been the source of most duplicates. :thinking_face:

Jon: good question. ledger is intended to be single-source-of-truth for active incident handoffs only — ephemeral and indexed by incident id. key fields: incident_id, current_oncall, next_oncall (handoff sleep window), current_status (mitigating / monitoring / resolved), immediate_action_items (short list text + owner + ETA), pm_ticket_link (optional), followup_snooze (timestamp). contrasts with spreadsheet which is for finalized PM writeups. ledger is mutable and API-driven.

Priya: this sounds useful. would want an API so that our postmortem generator can pull open action items and prefill PM templates. also need RBAC: some companies will want restricted visibility.

Alex: quick UX thought — make the ledger entries auto-created by PagerBot when an incident page is acknowledged with `ack` and then allow `/handoff update` from the oncall. e.g.:
```
/handoff create incident=INC-2356 owner=@Jon status=mitigating
/handoff update incident=INC-2356 add-item "remove bad retry" owner=@Maria eta=2026-04-05
```
then HandoffBot appends to the in-memory ledger and also pushes a lightweight card to the infra ops dashboard.

PagerBot: Auto-note: triggered page INC-2356 at 02:12 UTC, acknowledged by @Jon at 02:15. If you'd like, I can create a ledger entry automatically.

Jon: yes please — auto-create as long as the ack comes with `ack` command. otherwise ping the responder to confirm.

Sam: worried about noise: if the ledger auto-creates on every ack we may get a ton of short-lived entries for chaff pages. maybe require `ack --track` to opt-in? or make `/snooze` default 1h when not opted in.

Priya: opt-in `ack --track` seems reasonable. another feature request: when a PM is scheduled, the ledger should snapshot the items into the PM ticket (one-way) and mark the ledger entry as "handoff->postmortem". prevents duplicates.

Maria: +1. and a dashboard view that surfaces stale open action items older than X days would be high ROI for SRE managers. we could hook Redwood Optimize signals later for action churn analytics. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Alex: quick prototype idea for the snooze flow — allow commands like `/snooze 4h reason="wait for infra restart"` and the bot posts an ephemeral msg to the channel plus creates a followup task assigned to the oncall in the ledger with due ts. sample snippet: 
```
/snooze incident=INC-2356 duration=4h owner=@Jon reason="wait for scale-up"
```
HandoffBot: created followup for INC-2356 — due in 4 hours, assignee @Jon. Use `/handoff list incident=INC-2356` to view.

Jon: can the bot also create a PM stub ticket in Jira/GitHub Issues? I want the option to auto-create a ticket titled "PM: INC-2356 — followups" and add the assignees.

HandoffBot: integration checklist: jira_project, issue_type, default_assignee, pm_template_url. example: `POST /api/handoff/integrations` with `{ "jira_project": "REDINF", "issue_type": "Postmortem", "pm_template_url": "https://..." }`. returns ok if creds present.

Sam: question: retention and compliance — ledger entries will contain incident details. default retention? can we set per-team TTL and optional customer-data redaction?

Maria: yep — include a `redact_pii` flag and TTL param. default TTL for ledger = 90 days, PM artifacts still live in the postmortem store.

Priya: ops checklist for rollout: 1) opt-in mode (ack --track) for 30 days, 2) dashboard + stale-item alert, 3) PM ticket snapshot integration, 4) per-team TTL & RBAC, 5) analytics export for action-item closure rates.

Alex: I'll build a small prototype Lambda + Dynamo table to model ledger entries. will wire `/handoff` slash commands to the bot and a small Ember card in the infra dashboard. estimated ~2 wks to first demo.

Jon: sweet. final ask — can we include an escape hatch so oncall can mark a ledger followup as "no PM needed"? sometimes the work is ops housekeeping. mark `no_followup=true`.

HandoffBot: noted — `no_followup` is supported. created sample entry: INC-2356 {owner:@Jon, status:mitigating, followups:[{"remove bad retry", owner:@Maria, eta:2026-04-05}], no_followup:false}.

Maria: ok team — let's run the opt-in pilot next week for infra oncall. @Alex can you post the demo link and a 15-min walkthrough for Wednesday standup? :calendar:

Alex: yes — will post a demo thread and the repo link by Tues EOD.

Jon: thanks all. action items: Alex -> prototype, Priya -> RBAC & retention requirements, Maria -> stale-item dashboard mock, Sam -> privacy checklist. I'll follow up to schedule pilot. :spiral_notepad:
